module: Bridge between crawl mode (slow traversal of courses) and the missions' flowgraph nodes. It loads a trail from gameplay_crawl_saveSystem, prepares it (setupCrawl, with teleportation to the start), starts/stops/resets the crawl via gameplay_crawl_general and gameplay_crawl_utils, and exposes the crawl state (time, points, current node, disqualification, recoveries), the trail information and the management of penalties and recovery points. Unlike crawlFlowgraphBridge.lua, it keeps no state of its own: it reads gameplay_crawl_general.activeTrail and looks for the active crawler in gameplay_crawl_utils.getAllCrawlStates().
usage:
local b = gameplay_crawl_flowgraphBridge
local trail = b.loadCrawlTrail(trailId)
if trail and b.setupCrawl(nil, trail) then
  b.startCrawl(nil, trail)
end
notes: Expected call order: loadCrawlTrail -> setupCrawl -> startCrawl. startCrawl fails if setupCrawl has not been called.
setupCrawl teleports the vehicle to the start (isFromMission = true).
startCrawl: if an active crawl has not started yet (crawlStarted false), simply resumes its timer (resumeCrawlTimer) instead of restarting.
If vehicleId is nil, startCrawl tries the first crawler of gameplay_crawl_general.crawlersData, then player 0's vehicle; setupCrawl uses be:getPlayerVehicle(0).
stopCrawl and resetCrawl pass force = true to the utils functions.
resetCrawl does not stop the crawl: it resets the data and teleports to the start.
Penalty types: boundaryViolation, drivingBackwards, gateTouch, vehicleReset, wrongDirection, skippedCheckpoint, vehicleFlippedUpright, dnf.
The hooks onCrawlStarted, onCrawlResultsShown and onCrawlPathnodeReached are empty here (they exist so that flowgraph nodes can subscribe to them via extensions.hook).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: gameplay_crawl_saveSystem, general, utils, boundary, display.

loadCrawlTrail.desc: Gets a trail by id from saveSystem.

returns.desc: The trail, or nil if absent.

setupCrawl.desc: Prepares a crawl: stops any crawl in progress, then calls gameplay_crawl_general.setupCrawl(trail, veh, true) (zone, path, start, prefabs, teleport to the start).

vehicleId.desc: Vehicle id; player 0's vehicle if nil.

startCrawl.desc: Starts the prepared crawl (gameplay_crawl_general.startCrawlFlowgraph) or resumes the timer of a crawl that is already ready.

trail.desc: Trail; otherwise the active trail of general.

returns.desc: true if the crawl is started.
false if there was no active trail.

resetCrawl.desc: Resets the active crawler's data and teleports its vehicle to the trail's starting position (spawn.safeTeleport).

getCrawlEndData.desc: Summary of the active crawler's crawl.

returns.desc: {time, points, completed, pathnodesCompleted, pathnodeTimings, disqualified, recoveries}; nil if no active crawl.

getCrawlRuntimeData.desc: Current state of the active crawl.

returns.desc: {currentTime, currentPathnodeIndex, points, isCompleted, disqualified, crawlerPosition, crawlerDirection, vehicleId}; nil if no active crawl.

getTrailInfo.desc: Metadata of a trail (the one given, otherwise the active trail).

returns.desc: {name, description, pathId, boundaryId, startingPositionId, pathReversed, rules, prefabs, metadata}.

isCrawlActive.desc: Indicates whether a trail is active in gameplay_crawl_general.

getActiveCrawlerId.desc: Returns the id of the first crawler whose state is active.

applyPenalty.desc: Applies a penalty to the active crawler with the points from gameplay_crawl_utils.infractionPoints[penaltyType]. No effect if there is no active crawler or if the type is unknown.

penaltyType.desc: One of the types from getPenaltyTypes().

getLastRecoveryCheckpoint.desc: Last recovery point of the active crawler.

returns.desc: Recovery point (inferred from code); nil if no active crawler.

getLastRecoveryCheckpointIndex.desc: Index of the last recovery point of the active crawler.

setRecoveryCheckpoint.desc: Sets the active crawler's recovery point.

returns.desc: false if no active crawler, otherwise the result of utils.setRecoveryCheckpoint.

onCrawlStarted.desc: Hook called when a crawl starts: empty body.

onCrawlResultsShown.desc: Hook called when the results are shown: empty body.

onCrawlPathnodeReached.desc: Hook called when a path node is reached: empty body.

cleanup.desc: Stops the active crawl if there is one.
